findings.original_title: P2: Categorical Sort crashes whenever an ordered column contains a missing value
findings.resolution: Categorical ordering preserves missing labels, original dtypes, tie order and duplicate indexes.

findings.original_title: P2: Default parser-variable dictionaries are shared between independent sessions
findings.resolution: Each parser session owns its nested default-variable configuration; reads and writes use defensive copies.

findings.original_title: P2: Duplicate parser-variable IDs survive validation and one remove deletes multiple variables
findings.resolution: Parser-variable identities are unique and stable; malformed duplicate identities cannot delete unrelated variables.

findings.original_title: P2: One non-UTF-8 saved configuration crashes the entire configuration catalog
findings.resolution: Catalog discovery skips malformed encodings and reports usable configurations without aborting discovery.

findings.original_title: P2: Concurrent configuration imports bypass the requested logical-name conflict policy
findings.resolution: Logical-name conflict decisions and writes share a portable coordination lock.

findings.original_title: P1: Mean and Normalize return stale rows, uncertainties, metadata, and indexes from their shared caches
findings.resolution: Cache keys retain complete typed scientific inputs, axes, uncertainty and metadata. Unsupported recursive or extended scalar metadata bypasses reuse; RangeIndex uses compact complete bounds.

findings.original_title: P1/P2: Unit conversion leaves standard deviations in the old unit
findings.resolution: Affine conversions apply the scale magnitude to uncertainty and apply offsets only to measurements.

findings.original_title: P2: Portfolio restore can preserve unrelated old source and processed data
findings.resolution: Restore prepares a replacement repository outside the publication lock, clears unrelated source/processed data and publishes atomically; concurrent source replacement rejects the candidate.

findings.original_title: P2: Portfolio replay can silently overwrite a previous plot export after name disambiguation
findings.resolution: Portfolio replay allocates all output names against previously allocated names, including existing suffix collisions.

findings.original_title: P2: SplitApply silently creates Cartesian products for nonunique join columns
findings.resolution: SplitApply validates join cardinality and refuses ambiguous row alignment instead of multiplying observations.

findings.original_title: P2: Reviewed datetime imports accept mixed offsets, then fail at loading
findings.resolution: Reviewed mixed-offset datetimes load consistently in UTC; exact uint64 values are retained and unrepresentable mixtures fail during preview.

findings.original_title: P2: CSV metadata cache ignores file changes
findings.resolution: CSV metadata cache identity follows file replacement and current content/stat identity.

findings.original_title: P3: CSV metadata counts physical lines as records
findings.resolution: CSV metadata counts parsed CSV records, including quoted multiline fields.

findings.original_title: P2: Table.apply exposes its private backing frame to supported callables
findings.resolution: Table owns constructor, accessor and transformation object cells. Callables receive owned input and must return a DataFrame; invalid results surface as PipelineError at Table.apply.

findings.original_title: P3: Table.sort is not stable despite its public contract
findings.resolution: Table.sort uses stable ordering and preserves tied row order.

findings.original_title: P2: Editing portfolio metadata deletes tags for portfolios beyond the discovery cap
findings.resolution: Metadata pruning uses the complete portfolio catalog, independently of display discovery limits.

findings.original_title: P2: Autosave ignores changes to default variables' parser metadata
findings.resolution: Autosave detects custom parser-variable options while ignoring identity changes. The frozen follow-up also treats omitted/None/empty/"None" configuration fallbacks as the proven same effective default, preventing empty editor renders from starting the cooldown. Empty variable selection and genuinely custom options remain meaningful.
